title: Implement Message-ID to CID reindex tool
description:
Implement a maintenance tool that walks all blocks in the local IPFS store, attempts to parse each as a Usenet article, and rebuilds the Message-ID to CID SQLite map from scratch. Used for disaster recovery if the SQLite database is lost but IPFS blocks are intact. Artifact: transit/src/import/reindex.rs.

Acceptance:
- Walks IPFS block store and parses each block
- Non-article blocks are silently skipped
- Rebuilt index matches the original (test by comparing before/after on a known corpus)
- Progress reported every 1000 blocks
- --dry-run flag reports what would be indexed without writing to SQLite
